This was stated in the 8-K filed 2025-10-30, and the document describes Quick Suite as an agentic AI app that

citations.cited_text: •Launched Quick Suite agentic AI app that acts as an AI teammate – connecting to business data and apps, and letting employees interact with AI agents that can find insights, conduct research, and take actions across systems.

content.text: acts as an AI teammate – connecting to business data and apps, and letting employees interact with AI agents that can find insights, conduct research, and take actions across systems.
The 8-K filed 2026-07-30 describes Amazon Quick, which

citations.cited_text: •Made Amazon Quick—an intelligent AI work companion that helps manage, search, and automate digital workloads across email, calendar, local or cloud files, and custom workflows—even more capable, adding autonomous agents that customers set up in plain language to run continuously in the background and carry out multi-step tasks; a personalized activity feed that pulls email, messages, calendar, and tasks into one prioritized view; and 16 new integrations, including Adobe, Moody’s, and Snowflake.

content.text: helps manage, search, and automate digital workloads across email, calendar, local or cloud files, and custom workflows
, and it reports no time-savings or cost-savings percentage for complex tasks. The 8-K filed 2026-10-29 reports that

citations.cited_text: •Expanded Amazon Quick, an intelligent AI work companion, into Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.

content.text: expanded into Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, but it likewise gives no time-savings or cost-savings figure. Because no later filing reports a figure against these targets, the status is "No evidence yet," and the promise carries no deadline.

citations.cited_text: The program includes eight free AWS-designed AI courses and a new generative AI scholarship program to help more than 50,000 high school and university students from underserved and underrepresented communities gain AI skills.

. The later filings in the data do not report a figure for students helped through the scholarship program, so no evidence has been found yet for this target. The promise has no stated deadline of its own, and the status reflects only the absence of a reported result.
Amazon's 8-K filed 2025-07-31 announced that Amazon S3 Vectors would be introduced, and that it

citations.cited_text: •Amazon S3 Vectors, which delivers vector storage for AI agents, AI inference, and semantic search, reducing the cost of uploading, storing, and querying vectors by up to 90%.

content.text: delivers vector storage for AI agents, AI inference, and semantic search, reducing the cost of uploading, storing, and querying vectors by up to 90%.

The document provided for this check contains no later filings, so there is no evidence to compare against that figure. Because no later filing reports a measured reduction in the cost of uploading, storing, or querying vectors, the 90% target is neither confirmed nor refuted, and the status is "No evidence yet."
Amazon's 8-K filed on July 31, 2025 said it had introduced DeepFleet,

citations.cited_text: •Introduced DeepFleet, an AI model that makes Amazon’s one million+ robots work smarter by coordinating movements to find optimal paths and reduce bottlenecks, improving robot travel efficiency by 10%.

content.text: an AI model that makes Amazon's one million+ robots work smarter by coordinating movements to find optimal paths and reduce bottlenecks, improving robot travel efficiency by 10%.

The later filings provided to this review do not report a figure for that measure. The only robot mention in them is a Proteus update in a July 2026 8-K, which contains no travel-efficiency figure, so the status is "No evidence yet."
